scope.question: Do you help a client plan or carry out a sale, purchase or transfer of real estate?
scope.note: Consider work that directly advances a transaction, rather than general advice alone. Services pursuant to or resulting from a court or tribunal order have an exclusion; earlier work needs its own assessment.

scope.question: Do you help a client buy, sell or transfer a controlling interest in a legal entity or arrangement?
scope.note: Assess the transaction and the role you perform. A hypothetical sale or general tax advice alone is different from acting to progress a transaction.

scope.question: Do you receive, hold, control or manage client money or property to assist a transaction?
scope.note: Relevant exceptions include payment for your own services and specified court or government payments. Incidental handling for non-designated work is conditional and depends on the business providing no other designated services beyond this client-property service. Select Not sure if an exception may apply.

scope.question: Do you help organise or carry out equity or debt financing for a legal entity or arrangement?
scope.note: Include proposed entities. The work must directly advance the financing, rather than only provide general information about options.

scope.question: Do you help create or restructure legal entities or arrangements, including SMSF trusts?
scope.note: The scope includes relevant preparatory steps. Testamentary trusts are excluded. Whether detailed advice itself advances a structure depends on what it enables the client to do.

scope.question: Do you act as, or arrange someone to act as, an officeholder, trustee, partner or nominee shareholder for a client?
scope.note: Other specified positions, including attorneys of entities, may also be relevant. Court-ordered roles and an attorney for an individual require separate consideration under the precise service definition.

scope.question: Do you provide a registered office or principal business address for a client entity, or sell or transfer a shelf company?
scope.note: These are separate designated-service categories. Check the exact activities performed and any applicable exemptions.

scope.question: Do you broker property sales or transfers for sellers, for commission or other consideration?
scope.note: Both buyer and seller are customers of the brokerage service. The definition covers specified interests in Australian land, including leases longer than 30 years; it excludes some other interests.

scope.question: Do you act as a buyers’ agent to find, negotiate or buy real estate for a fee or commission?
scope.note: The buyer relationship starts when the agreement to find or identify a property is signed. The seller is also a customer when the transaction is reasonably expected to proceed.

scope.question: Does your business sell or transfer real estate directly to buyers, without an independent agent brokering the sale, as a business of selling real estate?
scope.note: Include off-the-plan property, subdivisions and sales through in-house staff. Construction alone and a one-off sale of your own premises are different. Assess the selling entity; select Not sure if a related entity or agency arrangement makes the position unclear.
